segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Hi Dana,

Attached is the updated summary for 38 seats, calibration scheduling, and the 2-hour admin training block. Target go-live is still March 18 if we have the asset list by March 6.

Thanks,
Mark

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Thanks Mark.

We’re good on 38 seats for now. Please confirm the invoice can be split 50% on signature and 50% at go-live. Our AP team also needs net 30, not due on receipt.

Dana

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Yeah, that works. I noted 50/50 billing and net 30 in the billing notes.

For the PO, use the $44,850 from our texts; I’ll get the order form cleaned up after the paperwork catches up.

Mark

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Ok. PO will reference $44,850 and 38 users.

One more thing: we have 612 instruments in the first import. Is that covered, or do we need the larger onboarding package?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
612 is covered. The standard onboarding includes up to 750 active instruments and one historical import file.

If you want us to clean up duplicates before import, that would be extra, but if your team sends the final CSV in the template, no added fee.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Got it. We’ll handle cleanup.

Can you send the template again? The one I have has columns for site and department, but our quality lead asked about location and owner too.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Sure. Attached is the newer template.

Required columns are asset ID, description, interval, next due date, and owner. Site and location are optional but recommended. Department can be blank if you don’t use it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Thanks. Legal is asking whether the initial term can end March 31, 2027 instead of March 17, 2027 so renewals line up with our fiscal calendar.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Yes, we can set the initial term through March 31, 2027. Renewal would then be annual starting April 1.

No change to the implementation timing or billing split.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Perfect. Send the final packet when ready and I’ll route for signature today.

Dana
